review_method: Independent retained-original text and map-pixel inspection, complete original/source joins, independent binary decoding, every ordered coordinate and whole-footprint comparisons where acquired maps permit. No external request or registered raster overlay.
cumulative_count_scope: Fresh recorded research verdicts, including holds and source-limited unresolved cases; not verified names or product approvals.

findings.supported_name_scope: The complete north-south polygon corresponds to the Dauphin Lake basin east of Dauphin and southwest of separately mapped Lake Winnipegosis: narrow northern end, west-bank indentation, broad southeastern body and rounded southern margin. Mossy River is a connecting outlet, not an included second lake.
limits: The two inspected figures are panels of one watershed plan, not two independent publications.
Printed publication date was not established; January 2016 creation and December 2017 modification are PDF metadata only.
Shoreline marsh margins fluctuate and the plan area is descriptive; no exact area, shoreline or formal registry equivalence is claimed. ECCC station rows are ordinary federal usage at two sites.

findings.supported_name_scope: Cold Lake remains a geographic name lead supported only by limited pre-existing text capture of an official subregional planning map. The actual source and retained baseline polygon are fully checked, but no acquired official full-lake map was available for independent correspondence review.
limits: The brochure, water-management overview and subregional-map original acquisitions returned 403; no original response body or body hash was obtained for them.

A retained text capture includes Cold Lake and a July 24, 2019 completion imprint. Its extraction hash cannot serve as an original PDF hash; a screenshot reference without displayed pixels is not visual inspection.
The WSA map does not supply a complete named Cold Lake view at its western edge. Location and label plausibility do not establish whole-feature correspondence.
Follow-up source coverage remains required. This bounded recorded verdict is not a completed full-source name assessment.

findings.supported_name_scope: The full bent, lobed source polygon agrees with the WSA mapped Deschambault waterbody: southern rounded basin, narrowed middle, western arm and broad northeastern part. Neighboring Wapawekka, Wood, Jan and Mirond waters provide context; they are not established included second lakes.
limits: The WSA thematic map is printed November 25, 2014 at 1:1,750,000. A 2025 URL folder and later HTTP metadata do not update its cartography.
This is ordinary provincial map usage from one publication. Full-ring regional comparison is not a datum-registered shoreline fit, surveyed name extent or current formal registry determination.
Natural Earth omits small bays, islands and other shoreline detail; surrounding waterbody labels were considered rather than transferred solely by overlap.

shared_limits: The original and retained baseline polygons contain 218 ordered positions matching at six-decimal quantization.
Four genuine naming-source bodies were inspected: two map publications and two HTML station indices. One unrelated redirect body is retained separately as an unused acquisition.
The Cold Lake record preserves a text-only capture and three failed acquisitions. It does not claim missing original map bytes, a map view or completed full-feature naming research.
No geometry repair, map republication, automated application or historical verdict restoration occurred.
